 Print MP Police SI Admit Card 2026 released for 507 Subedar and Sub-Inspector vacancies; candidates can download their hall tickets from esb.mp.gov.in ahead of the preliminary examination starting October 28. The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released the MP Police SI admit card 2026 for the preliminary written examination for Subedar and Sub-Inspector (SI) recruitment. Candidates who have registered for the examination can download their hall tickets from the official website, esb.mp.gov.in. The admit card was released on October 24, 2026. The preliminary written examination is scheduled to begin on October 28, 2026, at examination centres across Madhya Pradesh. The recruitment drive aims to fill 507 vacancies in the Home (Police) Department of the Madhya Pradesh government. Candidates must download their admit cards before the examination and check the details printed on them. The hall ticket contains important information, including the examination date, reporting time, and centre address. Candidates will not be allowed to enter the examination hall without a valid admit card. MP Police SI admit card 2026: Steps to download hall ticket
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the MP Police SI admit card 2026: Visit the official website of the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board at esb.mp.gov.in.
 Open the admit card section on the homepage.
 Click on the link titled “Test Admit Card - Police Sub-Inspector / Subedar Recruitment Test”.
 Enter the application number and date of birth in the designated fields.
 Provide the required verification details and solve the security captcha, if prompted.
 Submit the information to view the admit card.
 Download the hall ticket and take at least two printouts for future reference and examination-day use.
 Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the MP Police SI admit card 2026. MP Police SI hall ticket: Details to check
 After downloading the admit card, candidates should verify all the information printed on it. Any discrepancy should be reported to the examination authority promptly. The hall ticket may contain the following details: Candidate's name and roll number
 Application number
 Date of birth
 Photograph and signature
 Examination date and shift timing
 Reporting time and gate-closing time
 Examination centre name and address
 Instructions for the examination day
 Candidates should pay particular attention to the examination centre address, reporting time and entry deadline. They should plan their journey in advance to avoid delays on the day of the test. MP Police SI and Subedar exam date 2026
 The preliminary written examination for the MP Police Subedar and Sub-Inspector recruitment is scheduled to begin on October 28, 2026. The examination will be held at designated centres across Madhya Pradesh. Candidates should check their individual admit cards for their allotted examination date, shift and reporting time. They should not assume that the same shift timings or reporting schedule apply to all applicants. With the examination approaching, candidates should download their hall tickets without delay and read the instructions carefully. They should also confirm the location of their examination centre beforehand and allow sufficient time for travel and entry formalities.
